title: Evaluation Metrics Module
summary: This module provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, including both traditional exact-match/F1 scores and advanced LLM-based metrics for semantic F1, completeness, and groundedness.

nodes.label: Calculate Semantic F1
nodes.title: Semantic F1 Metric
nodes.description: Computes semantic F1 between prediction and ground truth using LLM-based precision/recall. Optionally uses a decompositional approach and applies a threshold.

nodes.label: Evaluate Completeness & Groundedness
nodes.title: Completeness & Groundedness Metric
nodes.description: Combines answer completeness and groundedness into a single score. Leverages separate LLM-based modules for each aspect with a configurable threshold.

nodes.label: LLM Signature: Semantic Recall/Precision
nodes.title: Semantic Recall/Precision Signature
nodes.description: DSPy Signature for an LLM to compare system response to ground truth, computing recall and precision based on key ideas.

nodes.label: LLM Signature: Decompositional Semantic Recall/Precision
nodes.title: Decompositional Semantic Recall/Precision Signature
nodes.description: DSPy Signature for an LLM to compute recall and precision by enumerating key ideas, discussing overlap, and reporting scores.

nodes.label: LLM Signature: Answer Completeness
nodes.title: Answer Completeness Signature
nodes.description: DSPy Signature for an LLM to estimate completeness of a system's response against ground truth, based on key idea enumeration and overlap.

nodes.label: LLM Signature: Answer Groundedness
nodes.title: Answer Groundedness Signature
nodes.description: DSPy Signature for an LLM to estimate groundedness of a system's response against retrieved context, analyzing claims and their support.

nodes.label: Check Exact Answer Match
nodes.title: Exact Match Evaluation
nodes.description: Evaluates if a prediction's answer exactly matches or meets an F1-threshold against a ground truth answer (string or list).

nodes.label: Check Passage for Answers
nodes.title: Passage Answer Check
nodes.description: Determines if a given passage contains any of the provided answer strings after normalization.

nodes.label: Calculate Token Precision
nodes.title: Token Precision Score
nodes.description: Computes the token-level precision of a predicted string against a ground truth string after normalization. Ratio of overlapping tokens to prediction tokens.

nodes.label: Calculate HotPotQA F1
nodes.title: HotPotQA F1 Metric
nodes.description: Calculates the maximum HotPotQA-style F1 score between a prediction and reference answers, handling 'yes/no/noanswer' cases.

nodes.label: Check Answer-Passage Match
nodes.title: Answer-Passage Match Evaluation
nodes.description: Checks if any passage within a prediction's context contains the ground truth answer(s), using normalized text for comparison.

nodes.label: Chain of Thought Module
nodes.title: DSPy Chain of Thought
nodes.description: A DSPy module that applies a Chain of Thought prompting strategy to a given signature, enabling multi-step reasoning.

groups.label: LLM-based Evaluation Modules
groups.title: LLM-based Evaluation Modules
groups.description: DSPy Modules that orchestrate LLM-powered evaluation metrics.

groups.label: LLM Evaluation Signatures
groups.title: LLM Evaluation Signatures
groups.description: DSPy Signatures defining the prompts for LLM-based evaluation tasks.

groups.label: Traditional Evaluation Metrics
groups.title: Traditional Evaluation Metrics
groups.description: Functions for calculating common, non-LLM-based evaluation scores.

groups.label: External DSPy Components
groups.title: External DSPy Components
groups.description: Core DSPy components utilized by this module for its functionality.
